title: Billing and Coding: Category III Codes

codes.1: The following lists Category III services determined by WPS GHA to be reasonable and medically necessary. Coverage will only be allowed when the service is delivered in clinical situations meeting medical necessity. For services addressed in a separate LCD and associated Billing and Coding Article, all criteria addressed in that LCD and associated Billing and Coding Article must be met.
codes.2: 0075T and 0076T Please refer to the CPT Professional code book: use 0076T in conjunction with 0075T.
codes.3: 0308T Claims submitted by Part A providers and ambulatory surgical centers for device pass-through category C1840 must be billed with HCPCS code 0308T (insertion of ocular telescope prosthesis including removal of crystalline lens) to receive pass-through payment. Effective July 1, 2012.
